segments.text: A high schooler who hopes to someday operate as a Nakano informant; 16 years old.

Though he admires Pollon and Cross (the feeling is not mutual), his aim is still, in his words, “to become Nakano’s untoppable, unstoppable guy in the chair”—hence why he hasn’t joined the Symphonies.
Wind is cheerful, friendly, and quick to recognize others’ good traits—all things considered, he’s pleasant to be around. He’s currently devoted to a very loving relationship with an AI character.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
An engineer serving as Asuma’s assistant at Gai Institution; 32 years old.
Ewan recognizes Asuma’s talent as the genuine article, and thus follows his orders without question—no matter if he’s belittled or ridiculed.
From Kiri Kiri Basara

segments.text: In 2031, the Japanese-American United National Defense Force was formed, through the union of the U.S. Armed Forces and the Japan Self-Defense Force, to bolster the Japanese-American Allied Forces.
Graham serves as a soldier of their Special Forces Group; he is 42 years old.
He commands a unit tasked with guarding the Gai Institution and Asuma, per top-secret orders passed down by the Ministry of Defense.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
A mathematician and researcher at Viktor Chondria University; 28 years old.
Liddie is very fond of solving worldly phenomena mathematically, and she makes a hobby out of showing others the wonders of mathematics.
Even aside from math, her numerous other talents garner her plenty of media presence and popularity.
From Kiri Kiri Basara

segments.text: An Agent belonging to the 5/13.
A man who rarely speaks, and never expresses emotion of any kind; many would even describe him as “mechanical.”
As a result, those around him tend to doubt his faith.
Edited from Kiri Kiri Basara

cast.characterName: フェリーノ・アルカナ
cast.originalCharacterName: フェリーノ・アルカナ

segments.text: An Agent belonging to the 5/13.
A very young, incredibly enigmatic girl in possession of a great deal of power among the Holy Office.
Edited from Kiri Kiri Basara
A mechanic friend of Pollon’s; 18 years old.
Dub, as he’s also called, joins in on gravbike street races with Pollon. He’s the son of the Tabuchi Motors auto repair shop’s manager.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
Another mechanic friend of Pollon’s; 16 years old.
Ando, as everyone calls him, is another gravbike street racer, but he prefers tinkering with the machinery over operating it. He’s also an employee at the Tabuchi Motors auto repair shop.
From Kiri Kiri Basara

Pollon is a young man with a dream: to be a super cool hero that anyone and everyone can look up to. In pursuit of that goal, he founded the “Nakano Symphonies,” a tag-team duo that helps out those in need. The fact that their activities center around white-hat hacking isn’t ideal, but… someone’s gotta pay the bills.

Pollon doesn’t excel at hacking, per se. But the insight he brings to the table—enabled by his innate ingenuity—and his dauntless personal demeanor allow him to infiltrate the locations he needs to get into; from there, getting his targets to dance to his tune and securing the information he’s looking for is a piece of cake.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
Momo and Pollon meet each other by complete chance—and when Pollon learns she’s being pursued by a shadowy force, he decides to help her flee them, staying ever true to his altruistic nature.
Momo’s background is rather elusive, and she is reluctant to reveal her identity. She is entirely unfamiliar with all forms of electronics, and has none on her when she first meets Pollon.
She appears 15 years of age.
Edited from Kiri Kiri Basara

Cross makes up the other half of the Nakano Symphonies. He’s quite knowledgeable, and is a rather talented hacker. What’s more, his excellent information-gathering and analysis skills allow him to relay valuable, real-time information to Pollon on the field.
As the older of the duo, Cross acts as a supportive big brother to Pollon.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
The face of the Cyber Force Dolls, established in the Office of Cyber Security Control under the TMPD Cyber Security Control Division; 19 years old.

Bambi joined the force as a police officer in April; she only started to be dispatched a few months prior to the game’s events. She’s a bit of a klutz, but she takes her work very seriously, and is always giving it her all.
As a police officer and an idol, she has her work cut out for her: she needs to attend officer training and idol practice every day.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
Another member of the Cyber Force Dolls; on stage, she stands left of Bambi. 19 years old.

Riko is a police officer from the TMPD Cyber Security Control Division; she just happened to be forced to audition for the Cyber Force Dolls, too. Despite her lack of interest in the position, she was chosen for it.
She may not be eager to do the work, but to her, that’s no reason to slack off; she always takes her job seriously.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
Another member of the Cyber Force Dolls; on stage, she stands right of Bambi. 21 years old.
Iroha is the oldest of the three-girl idol group, and has been a police officer the longest—thus, she is their de facto leader.
She may be well-mannered and quiet, but Iroha knows exactly who she is and what she wants; she doesn’t let anyone else’s opinions sway her own.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
A self-proclaimed jack-of-all-trades operating under his own Nakano detective agency; 37 years old.
Ozutani, aka Oz, is aware that he’s rather old-fashioned. Still, he chooses not to wear the ever-prevalent BMI—Brain Machine Interface—himself.

What he lacks in energy, Oz makes up for with his superb investigation and negotiation prowess, and his vast knowledge of the occult, urban legends, and conspiracy theories. He established the Tengen Ozutani Detective Agency years prior, all on his own.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
A hacker and gadget developer working for Oz’s detective agency; 10 years old.

She may not seem it, but Nonno (as she calls herself) is a cheeky girl who isn’t at all intimidated by adults. She’s firmly confident in her own abilities, and thanks to her cheerful personality, she has a lot of friends at school, too.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
The world’s greatest hacker; widely known by her hacker name, “JUNO.”
She takes part in the Cicada3301 quests from the outset.
She is feared by many thanks to her uncanny talent for showing up whenever—and wherever—she’s least expected.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
The boy in charge of developing GAIA under the Gai Institution; 14 years old.
As he rarely goes out in public, society at large knows nothing of Asuma’s existence.
He’s a prideful boy, even arrogant; friend or foe, he shows mercy to no one who dares display their incompetence.
From Kiri Kiri Basara

segments.text: An Agent belonging to the 5/13.
From childhood, Rosario was trained to subsist under a fiercely ascetic lifestyle, leading to her present, uncompromisingly stoic self.
She carries out her duties ever unperturbed, and always level-headed.
Edited from Kiri Kiri Basara
An Agent belonging to the 5/13.
A man of utmost loyalty to his mission; he grants no quarter to those who defy God.
The only thing stronger than his devotion to God is his devotion to combat—his physical abilities far surpass normalcy.
Edited from Kiri Kiri Basara
A genius hacker who suddenly disappeared in 2012.
After he hacked into the Vatican’s computer network in 2010, his abilities were recognized by the institution, and he was subsequently hired as their Head Computer Technician.
From Kiri Kiri Basara
The head of the Office of Cyber Security Control, and the Cyber Force Dolls’ boss; 27 years old.

Kaoru operates as the Dolls’ producer—a job foisted onto him by his superiors—and is earnestly fumbling his way through the work. He may act and seem like the strict, serious type, but he’s very flexible, no matter the situation he’s facing.

Back when he was a student, Kaoru was quite the exceptional hacker, which landed him a position in the TMPD Cyber Security Control Division. His abilities were quickly recognized, leading to him being put in charge of the Office of Cyber Security Control at a relatively young age.
From Kiri Kiri Basara

An artificial intelligence created for the Amadeus system based on the memories of Kurisu, who is a neuroscience researcher at an American university. The program essentially has the same personality as the original Kurisu.
